title: Configuration stride
statement: For a Boolean-input finite Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $N$ and $T$, define the configuration stride to be $k(2T+1)+N+3$, where $k$ is the parameter of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input
